agency.name: Ohio Department of Behavioral Health (DBH) — formerly Ohio Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services (OhioMHAS)

countyDirectory.name: Ohio ADAMH Board Directory — Ohio Association of County Behavioral Health Authorities (OACBHA)

narrNote: ORH is listed as Ohio's affiliate on NARR's official affiliates page (narronline.org/affiliates) and states the affiliation on its own homepage. Verified in-run 2026-10-22.
notes: OhioMHAS was renamed the Ohio Department of Behavioral Health (DBH) effective Oct. 1, 2025 (Am. Sub. H.B. 96); the new domain dbh.ohio.gov launched with the rename while mha.ohio.gov remains live (fetched 200 in-run) — agency phone is the main number published in the DBH site footer. Ohio CareLine (1-800-720-9616) is the department's free 24/7 emotional-support line, confirmed in the department's own bulletins; Ohio also routes 988 in-state and uses the Crisis Text Line keyword 4HOPE to 741741. Ohio Medicaid covers the full ASAM SUD continuum (levels 0.5-4.0) under its CMS Section 1115 SUD demonstration (CMS listing linked). Local services are planned and funded by 50 county ADAMH boards covering all 88 counties; OACBHA publishes the board directory linked here. Ohio 211 also answers at 888-OHIO-211.
